1_executive_email.body:
Dear Pharma company with Alzheimer's program + device division (e.g. Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Pharma company with Alzheimer's program + device division (e.g..

## Technology
P-04 — NEP enzyme immobilized on catheter wall clears Aβ42 via mass-transport-li

## Why This May Matter to Pharma company with Alzheimer's program + device division (e.g., Eli Lilly, Roche)
Catheter-based Aβ clearance is a device-drug combination. No current catheter-based clearance option exists. Could complement monoclonal antibody programs.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- 4/8 biology parameters blocked (enzyme stability, CSF kinetics unknown)

## What We Are Asking
Commission the decisive experiment ($15-30K (ESTIMATED: enzyme + ELISA + materials)) OR request technical diligence OR request co-development discussion. Licensing is a subsequent route after successful validation.

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$20-50K wet lab, 12-24 months to T2) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular

3_buyer_specific_reason.ideal_buyer: Pharma company with Alzheimer's program + device division (e.g., Eli Lilly, Roche)

5_nda_cda_trigger.trigger_point: When buyer requests full technical dossier (07_PREMIUM_DOSSIER.json) or evidence ledger
5_nda_cda_trigger.what_is_shared_pre_nda: This one-page summary + executive email. No proprietary data, no full evidence ledger, no model code.
5_nda_cda_trigger.what_is_shared_post_nda: Full 15-section dossier, evidence ledger with source artifacts, experiment protocols, model code references, competitive analysis, IP diligence status.

5_nda_cda_trigger.timeline_for_nda: Typically executed within 1-2 weeks of initial interest expression

6_technical_diligence_path.step_1_initial_review: Buyer reviews one-page summary + executive email (30 min)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_3_full_dossier_review: Buyer's technical team reviews full dossier + evidence ledger (1-2 weeks)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_4_technical_qa: Conference call with CereVascular technical team (1 hour)
6_technical_diligence_path.step_5_validation_decision: Buyer decides: commission validation experiment, request co-development, or pass
